name: Cross-pool overshoot rebound
hypothesis: Buy only after the cheap pool's executable price starts reverting and independent reference venues stay stable.
spec: Setup: A local pool can temporarily overreact relative to deeper independent markets. Entry: Buy only after the cheap pool's executable price starts reverting and independent reference venues stay stable. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when the gap closes or reference venues move down materially. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs swap-level flow and trade-size cohorts over time (not connected)
